# Numerics Requirements Quality Checklist: R02-F03 — Numerical foundations and deterministic seeded scene time

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the R02-F03 requirements: completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, lifecycle and
failure coverage, privacy and no-advertising, accessibility, simulator/device split, traceability.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated 2026-11-13 by the lead under the owner's standing delegation. Two items failed first (CHK011, CHK015); the
specification was corrected and each item notes the correction.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does every purpose item of the source prompt (clock, seed hashing, stable math, IEEE hygiene, replay, transforms) map to a requirement or a documented reuse? [Traceability, Spec §Absorbed source requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Is the reuse disposition of section 13 stated with the existing names it relies on? [Completeness, Spec §Input]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for keeping existing generator output and committed digests unchanged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-R02F03-002]
- [x] CHK004 Does every new helper have a named consumer requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-R02F03-071]
- [x] CHK005 Are superseded source items (price model, Round 2 lock) recorded with the reason? [Traceability, Spec §Absorbed]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the derivation rule specified exactly enough to reproduce golden values independently? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-R02F03-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the number of draws per owned algorithm stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F03-023]
- [x] CHK008 Is the saved-state format (version, fields, encoding) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F03-031]
- [x] CHK009 Are the ranges of angle normalization and wrapping stated as half-open intervals? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F03-051, 052]
- [x] CHK010 Is the location of the determinism document named? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F03-060]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the "never crash on degenerate input" edge case and the low-level index mapping consistent? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases] — failed first: the mapping needs n ≥ 1; corrected: documented precondition for the low-level mapping, reporting for pick, weighted choice, wrapping and quantization.
- [x] CHK012 Is the saved state consistent with the generator's equality (seed included)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-R02F03-031, §FR-R02F03-033]
- [x] CHK013 Is keeping A04's hand-made offset consistent with the unchanged-digest requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-R02F03-013, 002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Are all success criteria expressed as counts or ratios with fixed sample sizes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-R02F03-001..008]
- [x] CHK015 Is the GPU parity criterion achievable exactly for every hash it covers? [Measurability, Spec §FR-R02F03-041] — failed first: float hashes cannot be compared exactly on the GPU; corrected: GPU parity for `vc_pcg`, CPU-only goldens for the float hashes.
- [x] CHK016 Are test sizes bounded (owner ruling: short tests)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-R02F03-072, SC-R02F03-008]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are invalid saved states (short, all zero, newer version, malformed) covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-R02F03-032, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are non-finite inputs covered for every hygiene helper? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-R02F03-050..053]
- [x] CHK019 Are lifecycle, memory pressure and cancellation addressed (as not applicable with the reason)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional, Privacy, Accessibility, Device Split

- [x] CHK020 Is it stated that no requirement needs a device and where cross-device determinism is observed? [Coverage, Spec §Input, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK021 Is accessibility recorded as not applicable with a reason? [Accessibility, Spec §Absorbed]
- [x] CHK022 Are licensing and provenance of the algorithms addressed? [Compliance, Spec §Absorbed, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Is it clear the feature adds no network, advertising or data collection? [Privacy, Spec §Input (pure package helpers only)]
